meta.title: About NestSelf
meta.description: NestSelf is an employee wellbeing programme offering therapy, legal and financial support in Serbia and Hungary. Meet the team and learn how we work with professionals.

hero.title: Wellbeing at work means more than therapy
hero.lead: NestSelf was founded on a simple idea: workplace support should include legal and financial questions, not only therapy. We bring licensed psychologists, qualified psychotherapists, legal professionals and financial consultants together in one confidential benefit.

photo.alt: The NestSelf team at work in the Belgrade studio

mission.title: Why we built NestSelf
paragraphs: Employees deal with more than stress. A tenancy dispute, a question about parental leave or a debt problem can weigh just as heavily as anxiety — and one often leads to the other.

Traditional EAPs cover psychological support but leave legal and financial questions to chance. NestSelf brings all three together in one confidential benefit, so your people can get help where they actually need it.

photo.alt: A modern, bright office where the NestSelf team works

steps.title: Licence verification
steps.body: Every professional's licence and credentials are verified before they join the network.

steps.title: Interview and references
steps.body: We interview every candidate and check professional references.

steps.title: Code of ethics and supervision
steps.body: Professionals commit to a shared code of ethics and participate in regular supervision.

steps.title: Languages
steps.body: Sessions are available in Serbian, Hungarian and English. Professionals are matched by language and area of expertise.

steps.title: Ongoing feedback
steps.body: We collect anonymous feedback from users to maintain and improve quality.

team.title: Who we are
team.lead: A small team in Belgrade and Budapest, working across psychology, law, finance and technology.

members.body: Built NestSelf to close the gap between what employees need and what traditional EAPs offer.
Licensed psychologist overseeing the therapy network, supervision and professional standards.
Leads the legal consultation network and ensures compliance with data protection law in Serbia and Hungary.
Certified financial professional leading the financial guidance service.
Manages launches, employer relationships and day-to-day operations across both countries.

whereWeAre.title: Where we are
paragraphs: Belgrade and Budapest, with professionals and team members working remotely across both countries.

cta.title: Get in touch
cta.body: Want to learn more about NestSelf or explore a partnership? We would love to hear from you.
